title: Android Auto gets a massive upgrade with Personal Intelligence
content_html:
Published Oct 20, 2026, 5:43 PM EDT

Timi is the news and deals reporter for Android Police, who has been reporting on technology since 2008. He has worked in tech retail and also the IT space, providing hardware and software support, which gives him a unique perspective on the tech that he covers. This allows him to effectively break down complex subjects into easy-to-read pieces that even casual readers can enjoy. Before joining Android Police, he was a news writer for XDA, where he eventually transitioned to covering deals. He also worked as an editor and reporter for Neowin, where he covered news and attended major tech events like CES. He also reviewed phones, tablets, PC products, and other devices. In addition, he also created video content for the Neowin YouTube channel.

Personal Intelligence with Gemini is now rolling out to Android Auto. This experience will take Google's AI to another level, providing "uniquely tailored answers" that"make Gemini even more valuable on the road." We've seen what this can do on Android phones, so we are quite excited that this powerful feature can now be accessed while on the road.

Android Auto is leveling up

We've seen Google insert whatever AI features it can into its products and services, so it was only a matter of time before Personal Intelligence found its way into Android Auto. And if you're not familiar, this is going to be a huge upgrade.

What makes Personal Intelligence so powerful is that it can utilize all your information across all Google products in order to provide the best answer and experiences. So, Gmail, Calendar, YouTube, Search, and more can all work together to deliver the best answers available to any queries you might have.

Google makes this easy to understand, sharing that "Personal Intelligence has two core strengths: retrieving specific details from, say, an email, photo or a place you saved in Google Maps to answer your question and reasoning across complex sources. That’s especially helpful when your hands are on the wheel."

And you can do all of this using your natural voice. There are no prompts here. Just ask Gemini back to back questions, and it will find the answers you're looking for.

Personal Intelligence is a game changer

There's this fantasy where AI handles everything that's thrown at you every single day and makes it all manageable. We haven't quite reached that point, but with more integration, it's slowly inching toward a new reality. Personal Intelligence is just one step in this direction, and Android users have been lucky enough to experience it.

Since Google's Gemini with Personal Intelligence can tap into a variety of Google products and services, it becomes more useful, seamlessly taking the necessary data and putting it to work in the background. It really becomes the personal assistant you've been looking for that lives on your phone.

The most important part is that it remembers your preferences, so you don't waste time retraining the AI to match your preferred outputs. As you can imagine, this is powerful stuff, and it's with you all day long. And now, it's here on Android Auto, where having a more productive AI partner can become a game changer.

With privacy in mind

No, the big thing here is that you're granting Google access to all your information. If you don't want to do that, you're welcome to block access at any time. This isn't something that you have to use, it's just something new that could help you with your day. I know people that love utilizing these features, while others will refuse to give Google more information than they need.

It's really up to you. None of this is necessary. You can just keep on doing things as you please, and I don't think you'll miss out on much. But eventually, this might become the new way of life, and you might be forced to get on board.
